message.content:
Here’s a quick reference to the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday (or a holiday that is observed on the nearest weekday if it lands on a weekend).  

| Date | Day | Holiday | Notes |
|------|-----|---------|-------|
| **January 1** | Sunday | New Year’s Day | Observed on Monday, Jan 2 |
| **January 16** | Monday | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | |
| **February 20** | Monday | Louis‑Riel Day (Manitoba) | |
| **March 20** | Monday | St. Patrick’s Day (New Brunswick) | |
| **April 7** | Monday | Good Friday | |
| **April 10** | Thursday | Easter Monday (Ontario, Quebec, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island) | Not a public holiday in all provinces |
| **May 22** | Monday | Victoria Day | |
| **June 19** | Monday | National Indigenous Peoples Day (British Columbia) | |
| **July 1** | Saturday | Canada Day | Observed on Monday, July 3 |
| **August 7** | Monday | Civic Holiday (most provinces) | |
| **September 4** | Monday | Labour Day | |
| **October 9** | Monday | Thanksgiving Day | |
| **November 7** | Monday | Remembrance Day (observed in some provinces) | |
| **December 25** | Monday | Christmas Day | |
| **December 26** | Tuesday | Boxing Day | |

### Long‑Weekend Summary

| Long Weekend | Dates Covered | Total Days Off |
|--------------|---------------|----------------|
| New Year’s | Dec 31 – Jan 2 | 3 days (Dec 31 Sat, Jan 1 Sun, Jan 2 Mon) |
| Family Day | Jan 14 – Jan 16 | 3 days (Jan 14 Fri, Jan 15 Sat, Jan 16 Mon) |
| Louis‑Riel Day | Feb 18 – Feb 20 | 3 days (Feb 18 Fri, Feb 19 Sat, Feb 20 Mon) |
| St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 18 – Mar 20 | 3 days (Mar 18 Fri, Mar 19 Sat, Mar 20 Mon) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 – Apr 10 | 4 days (Apr 7 Fri, Apr 8 Sat, Apr 9 Sun, Apr 10 Mon) |
| Victoria Day | May 20 – May 22 | 3 days (May 20 Fri, May 21 Sat, May 22 Mon) |
| National Indigenous Peoples Day | Jun 17 – Jun 19 | 3 days (Jun 17 Fri, Jun 18 Sat, Jun 19 Mon) |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 – Jul 3 | 3 days (Jul 1 Sat, Jul 2 Sun, Jul 3 Mon) |
| Civic Holiday | Aug 5 – Aug 7 | 3 days (Aug 5 Fri, Aug 6 Sat, Aug 7 Mon) |
| Labour Day | Sep 2 – Sep 4 | 3 days (Sep 2 Fri, Sep 3 Sat, Sep 4 Mon) |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 7 – Oct 9 | 3 days (Oct 7 Fri, Oct 8 Sat, Oct 9 Mon) |
| Remembrance | Nov 5 – Nov 7 | 3 days (Nov 5 Fri, Nov 6 Sat, Nov 7 Mon) |
| Christmas | Dec 23 – Dec 26 | 4 days (Dec 23 Fri, Dec 24 Sat, Dec 25 Sun, Dec 26 Mon) |

> **Tip:** Some holidays (e.g., Easter Monday, Remembrance Day) are only statutory in certain provinces, so the long‑weekend length may vary regionally.

Feel free to copy/paste this table into your holiday‑planning app or let me know if you’d like it formatted differently!
